content:
**Iron Fist** is a Strength-based perk in *Fallout 76*.

Every 10 points of DR equals a 1% increase in melee damage, only applicable to fist weapons as tabulated below. The maximum bonus caps at 100% when DR reaches 1000, and other types of resistance have no effect. It belongs to the same category as melee damage boosts from Strength or other sources, and they stack additively.

| Rank | Cost | Description | Form ID | 
| ★ | 1 | Your Fists deal more damage based on your DR. | 0001DAFE | 

| Weapons affected by this perk: | | 
| Base weapon | Variant(s) | 
| Bear Arm | - | 
| Boxing glove | - | 
| Death tambo | - | 
| Deathclaw gauntlet | Unstoppable Monster | 
| Gauntlet | - | 
| Knuckles | - | 
| Meat hook | - | 
| Mole miner gauntlet | - | 
| Power fist | Face Breaker | 
| Unarmed | - | 

Previously, the first rank of the perk increased unarmed melee damage by 10%, with the second and third rank each granting an additional 5%.

The perk is a reference to the fictional Marvel Comics character Iron Fist, who channels his chi in order to unleash powerful unarmed attacks.
